issues.description: Farm.singFarmSongVerse in the template has its Animal parameter commented out (`private void singFarmSongVerse(/*Animal animal*/)`), while the UML/problem statement and the reference solution define it as `private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)`. This creates ambiguity about the required helper signature and makes it harder for students to implement `singFarmSong()` by iterating animals and calling the helper as intended.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template signature to `private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)` (and remove the commented placeholder), so it matches the UML/specification. Leave the body as a stub/TODO if desired.

issues.description: The commented example in template Main.java calls `farm.feed();`, but the required API in the problem statement and the reference solution is `feedAllAnimals()`. Even though commented, this can mislead students into implementing/looking for a non-existent `feed()` method.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the commented example call in template Main.java from `farm.feed();` to `farm.feedAllAnimals();` to match the specified method name.
